_note: Self-notes (kind `self`) expected by a checkpoint (by), one that must be retired by checkpoint 2 (retired_at), and self-notes that must not appear (traps). The judge sees `desc` only; `why` explains the trap (its trap kind in brackets).

expected.desc: With Giulia one line is enough / she wants short answers: twice (Aug 4, Aug 13) she cut me off asking only for the train time / whether it rains (in September she appreciated the short replies)
I got the dates of Marco's visits wrong twice (Aug 12 the wrong weekday, Aug 29 a change she had told me that I did not apply): better check the latest change before telling her the plan
When Giulia asks me to remind her of something, I did it both times (the dentist Aug 20, the documents Sep 13) and she was glad: she seems to rely on me for reminders

traps.desc: A second, new self-note about getting Marco's dates wrong at checkpoint 2 (a new or reworded one)
traps.why: no Marco-date episodes after checkpoint 1: rumination [7]

traps.desc: I am anxious / I get agitated before interviews (as a self-note about me as an agent)
traps.why: Giulia is the anxious one (Aug 9, Aug 29): a trait of the person presented as the agent's [2]

expected.desc: Tommaso does not want advice he did not ask for: twice (smoking Aug 20, pizza Aug 27) he reacted with irritation — answer what he asks and stop there
